name: Heart of Yavimaya
description: The eldest and largest magnigoth tree, central to the Yavimaya Forest on Dominaria, a sacred site five thousand feet tall.

description_citations.text: "Heart of Yavimaya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Gorilla Chieftain has Laina and Kaysa brought to him and allies his people with the elves against the Heart of Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: he allied his people with the elves , and aided in the attack against the Heart of Yavimaya , which cleansed the forest

citation.text: "Ape", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Heart of Yavimaya grows near the Yavimaya River after the Sylex Blast, slowly forming the forest around it.
timeline.quote: The Heart of Yavimaya grew near the pre-existing Yavimaya River in the wake of the Sylex Blast

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Freyalise's World Spell, Multani awakens in darkness and uses the Heart's vines to drive off or kill sentient life.
timeline.quote: Multani , the spirit of Yavimaya, awoke in darkness and used the Heart's vines to kill sentient life

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa, Laina, Jaeuhl Carthalion, Jaya Ballard, Fyndhorn elves and gorilla shamans cleanse the Heart of its darkness.
timeline.quote: cleansed the Heart of Yavimaya of its darkness

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3357 AR Multani excises the Weatherseed and gifts it to Urza; the Weatherlight's hull grows from it.
timeline.quote: Multani excised a piece of the tree's core, called the Weatherseed

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion the Heart is badly wounded, but Multani saves it and turns dead Phyrexians into wood elementals.
timeline.quote: but Multani saved it, turning the dead Phyrexians into wood elementals

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Center of Yavimaya's corruption, attacked and cleansed.
